description: Use the Salesforce Dashboards REST API under /services/data/v{version}/analytics on the registered org. Operations: list (GET /analytics/dashboards; the vendor's recently used dashboards), clone (POST /analytics/dashboards with query cloneId; optional body such as folderId or name), describe (GET /analytics/dashboards/{dashboard_id}/describe; query loadComponentProperties), results (GET /analytics/dashboards/{dashboard_id}; query runningUser, filter1, filter2, filter3), refresh (PUT /analytics/dashboards/{dashboard_id}; query runningUser, filter1, filter2, filter3; optional body filters), status (GET /analytics/dashboards/{dashboard_id}/status; query runningUser, filter1, filter2, filter3), update (PATCH /analytics/dashboards/{dashboard_id}; query isStickyFilterSave; body dashboard metadata) and delete (DELETE /analytics/dashboards/{dashboard_id}). Salesforce permissions alone decide each operation, including saves and deletes. Returns job_id/status queued.
embedding_description: Work with Salesforce dashboards: list recently used dashboards, describe a dashboard's layout and components, read its component results with optional filters, trigger a refresh and check refresh status, clone it into a folder, save changes, or delete it. Use for CRM dashboard data and maintenance; org permissions decide.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued dispatch: job_id and status. Completion: family, operation, method, status (HTTP), selected headers, body (dashboard list entries with id, name and statusUrl; describe with components, layout and filters; results with componentData, each component's reportResult and status; a refresh with statusUrl; refresh status per component with refreshDate and refreshStatus IDLE or RUNNING), correlation_id and error_code for a 4xx/5xx or unknown status.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Relay each component's header and aggregates; a component whose refreshStatus is RUNNING has not finished refreshing, so call status before reading results again. Clone, update, refresh and delete change the org; queued means only that the job was accepted.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Call the Salesforce Dashboards REST API with the registered user's permissions.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params is raised before any vendor call when the operation, dashboard_id or cloneId (15- or 18-character ids), a documented query parameter (runningUser and cloneId as 15- or 18-character ids, filter1, filter2, filter3, and the booleans loadComponentProperties and isStickyFilterSave) or a required body does not match the vendor shape. Vendor HTTP errors are completion data with error_code: sf.bad_request (400), sf.session_expired or sf.auth_failed (401), sf.permission_denied (403, for example a refresh limit or folder access), sf.rate_limited, sf.not_found (404), sf.api_error otherwise.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Read the status and the vendor message before retrying. Salesforce limits how often a dashboard can be refreshed; wait for status to report IDLE instead of refreshing again. A permission error means the registered user lacks access to the dashboard or its folder in Salesforce.
